slides.title:
Data science from any PhD.
No CS degree needed.
slides.body: What you already have, and 2 skills to add.
slides.say: Want to move into data science with a P H D in any field? You don't need a computer science degree. Here's what you already have, and two skills to add.

slides.title: Experiments, stats, messy data.
slides.body: Controls and confounders are the core of A/B testing. Cleaning data is most of the week.
slides.say: You already design experiments, run statistics, and clean messy data. That's the core of A B testing, and most of a data scientist's week.

slides.title: Learn SQL.
slides.body: Academic data rarely lives in databases. It shows up in almost every interview.
slides.say: Skill one. Learn S Q L. Academic data rarely lives in a database, but S Q L shows up in almost every interview.

slides.title: Think like the business.
slides.after: Found 3 factors behind engagement and shaped advising changes.
slides.say: Skill two. Think like the business. Not, ran regressions on survey data. Instead, found three factors behind engagement, and shaped real changes.
